annotations.title: Korean business registration status (NTS): active, suspended or closed, VAT type, closure date

description: Use when an agent must check that a South Korean business is still operating before paying, contracting or onboarding it (KYB). Input: b_no (1-20 business registration numbers, comma-separated, hyphens ok). Output: JSON per number: status (active, suspended, closed, unregistered, or no_answer: unknown, registered null), VAT taxpayer type, closure date, tax-type change and e-invoice dates, companyId. Data: NTS, synced every 30 min. Use instead: kr_supplier_check for a combined vetting; kr_company_profile for company details. Example: ?b_no=1248100998 Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

b_no.description: Business registration numbers (사업자등록번호), 10 digits each, comma-separated (max 20); invalid check digit → 400, not charged
